svg.title: Plunger electronics, concept
svg.desc: Concept schematic, not the real device: a single motor-control board on the left is wired to five jobs on a lightly drawn plunger tower: the drop release in the head, the ligand sprayer, two ring-shaped timing sensors, a gas-exchange manifold around the dewar opening whose sweep (dashed arrows) carries the cold vapour away from the drop path, and the liquid-nitrogen dewar.
